name: V2Table0203Fr
title: HL7v2 table 0203, French INS code
description: INS code for HL7 v2 table 0203 (Identifier Type), added by IHE PAM FR and absent from the international table: a PID-3 with CX-5 equal to INS carries the patient's national health identifier. Limited to the code used in this demo; included alongside the international table in ValueSet v2-0203-fr, bound to CX-5 by demo-CX.json.
